title: MineDeck · Minecraft server manager for Windows
description: A Minecraft: Java Edition server manager for Windows. It downloads Java and the server software, and lets you create, import and manage servers in one window. Open source, MIT.
changelogDescription: Release notes for every MineDeck version, with stable and beta releases marked.

hero.lead: A Minecraft: Java Edition server manager for Windows. It downloads Java and the server software, then lets you create, import and manage servers in one window.
hero.note: A single exe, no installer. Put it in its own folder and run it. The exe is not code-signed; if Windows SmartScreen appears, choose More info → Run anyway. Windows only. The app interface is in Chinese.
hero.shotAlt: MineDeck server list with four servers: Paper, Forge, Vanilla and Velocity

features.sub: Everything below is in the stable release {stable}.

items.d: Vanilla, Paper, Purpur, Leaves, Folia, Fabric, NeoForge, Forge, Mohist, Banner, plus the Velocity and Waterfall proxies. Minecraft 1.12.2 and later, including the year-numbered 26.x.

Picks Java 8, 16, 17, 21 or 25 for the game version. Uses a suitable local install if there is one; otherwise downloads a private runtime into the app folder without changing system environment variables.

The Mojang manifest, vanilla server and Forge/NeoForge installs go through BMCLAPI; Java tries Tsinghua TUNA first. Official sources are the fallback. Downloads are checksum-verified. Paper, Purpur and some others have no China mirror.
Modrinth .mrpack files import directly; loader and version are read from the pack and client-only files are skipped. CurseForge zips need your own CurseForge API key.

Live console with GBK/UTF-8 switching, coloured warnings and errors, and Tab completion for commands and player names. All 78 server.properties settings in 7 groups, with descriptions and restart hints (descriptions in Chinese).
Online players, whitelist, operators and bans, plus kicking. When the server is stopped, the list files are edited directly. Offline-mode UUIDs are computed for you.

Back up while the server is running; 10 backups kept per server by default. Crash restart is off by default; when on it backs off at 10, 30 and 60 seconds and stops after 3 failures. Daily scheduled restarts, commands or backups.
OpenFrp, SakuraFrp or your own frps. frpc is downloaded automatically and credentials are stored encrypted. A tunnel can be bound to a server and start with it; copy the public address from the page.
13 rules flag common startup problems at the top of the console, such as missing dependencies, client-only mods on the server, a busy port or an unaccepted EULA. No AI involved.

Streams what is playing on the host PC to players through Simple Voice Chat. NeoForge 1.20.5+, Forge and Mohist 1.20.1+. Windows 11 can capture a single app; Windows 10 captures the whole output device. Does not need AI.

With an access password set, manage servers from a phone browser on your LAN. Local HTTP API and Webhook events. The MCP interface is off by default, local-only, and write actions must be confirmed in MineDeck.

Minimise to tray and start with Windows. 7 colour schemes in light, dark or system mode. Updates are checked from settings and the exe must match the official SHA-256. Stable builds are never offered betas.

ai.sub: Requires your own API key. Without one, no AI service is contacted and everything else works as usual.

items.d: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Claude Messages. Presets for DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Zhipu, OpenAI, Claude and Ollama (local, no key), or a custom endpoint. Keys are encrypted with DPAPI on your PC. The provider bills you; MineDeck estimates cost from public prices and supports daily limits.
Reads logs, configs and crash reports before answering; local paths and secrets are removed from what is sent. Writes such as config edits, Java changes or restarts show a confirmation card first.
Players ask with @AI in chat. Per-player and server-wide daily limits for requests and tokens. Authorised players can have the model run whitelisted commands; op and execute are never run.
Server-side companion entities that follow, gather, fight and hand items to players. NeoForge 1.21.1 and Forge 1.20.1; friends install the matching companion mod on their client.

beta.sub: Available since {introduced}, not yet in a stable release. Run betas in a separate folder and back up existing servers first.

items.d: Pack a stopped server into a .mdpack for MineDeck on another PC, either for the next owner or for a friend to start a copy. The server jar is left out by default and downloaded again on import. Config files go in as-is, including any passwords in them.
Pick Modrinth mods into a cart from the setup wizard or server details, filtered by loader and version. Dependencies can be checked, and required ones are installed together.
Choose an existing server folder; MineDeck detects the loader, version and start file read-only and registers it in place. Files stay where they are and the original run.bat is backed up.
Modpack files that cannot be downloaded or verified no longer fail the whole import. Skip them, replace them with local files, or download them after reading the risk notice.
Switch Java for each server under Memory / Startup. If a modpack declares a newer Java, MineDeck warns but does not block startup.

shots.sub: Taken on v2.9.0-beta.1; beta-only screens are not shown. The app interface is in Chinese.

log.legacyNote: MineDeck was called AutoMCHUB; 2.x releases ship AutoMCHUB.exe. When upgrading from v2.6.1, auto-update cannot find the renamed file, so place MineDeck.exe in the old folder manually.
log.notesLang: Release notes are written in Chinese.

oss.p: MineDeck is MIT-licensed. If it is useful to you, a Star on GitHub helps. Report problems in Issues, and never paste API keys, MCP tokens, tunnel credentials or CurseForge keys there.
